basic_details.job_title: ISRO HSFC Medical Officer SD Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.post_name: Medical Officer SD (General Medicine, Physiology, Aerospace Medicine)
basic_details.job_location: Bengaluru (or any Centre/Unit of ISRO/DOS in India)

application_fee.sc_fee: ₹750/- (Initially paid, fully refunded upon appearing for Interview) / Non-refundable application fee component is ₹0 for these categories.
application_fee.all_other_candidates_fee: ₹750/- initially paid. ₹250/- is a non-refundable application fee, and ₹500/- is refunded upon appearing for Interview.
application_fee.details: Candidates must remit the application fee using only the BharatKosh/NTRP portal and attach the payment receipt/challan with the application form. The fee payment deadline is 8 November 2026.

age_limit.details: There is no upper age limit for post codes 1 to 3.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: MD or DNB General Medicine (Internal Medicine)

qualification.details: Only Indian nationals need to apply. | Foreign degrees must be valid and duly ratified by the National Medical Commission of India as equivalent to MBBS/MD. Essential qualifications must be recognized and registered with the Medical Council of India, State Medical Council, or National Medical Commission. Candidates who pursued professional courses through Open and Distance Learning (ODL) are not eligible. Candidates should possess at least second class in MBBS and MD with compulsory rotatory internship.

salary_details.details: In addition to Basic Pay & NPA, Dearness Allowances (DA), House Rent Allowances (HRA), and Transport Allowance (TA) are payable as per extant rules. Employees will be governed by the National Pension System / Unified Pension Scheme. Medical facilities for self and dependents, subsidized canteen, quarters facility in lieu of HRA, Leave Travel Concession, Group Insurance, House Building Advance, and other benefits are admissible as per DOS/Central Government orders.

selection_process: The mode of selection is through Interview. Initial screening based on the application will be conducted for shortlisting candidates for the interview.

Qualification prescribed is the minimum requirement and does not automatically make candidates eligible for interview or selection. The final selection will be based solely on performance in the interview.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure-I) from the official website.
Neatly type the application in the prescribed format and sign it.
Remit the application fee through the BharatKosh/NTRP portal and obtain the payment receipt.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates and mark lists in proof of educational qualification, work experience, age, and the fee receipt.
Place the completed application form and all requisite documents in a sealed envelope superscribed as "APPLICATION TO THE POST OF MEDICAL OFFICER – SD, POST CODE NO: [Enter Post Code]".

Send the application exclusively by ordinary post to the Administrative Officer, Recruitment Section, Human Space Flight Centre (HSFC), Department of Space, Doddannekundi, Bengaluru, Karnataka - 560037.
Ensure the application reaches HSFC on or before 8 November 2026. Hand-delivered applications or those sent via email or other modes will not be considered.
important_instructions: Candidates intending to apply for more than one post must submit separate applications for each post. Handwritten applications will not be accepted. All columns in the application form must be filled mandatorily; incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Recent colour passport-sized photographs (not older than 6 months, size 7cm x 5cm) with a plain/white background must be pasted in the designated space, signed below in the box in blue ink. Selfies are not allowed. Central or State government, PSU, or autonomous body employees must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of the personal interview. Outstation candidates called for personal interview will be paid to-and-fro Second Class Railway Fare or non-AC bus fare or actual fare, whichever is less, by the shortest distance upon successful document verification. HSFC/ISRO reserves the right to place selected candidates in any of its Centres or Units situated anywhere in India.

faq.question: Q1. What is the ISRO HSFC Medical Officer SD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment notification released by the Human Space Flight Centre (ISRO HSFC) to fill 4 temporary vacancies of Medical Officer SD in General Medicine, Physiology, and Aerospace Medicine.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 4 vacancies are available, categorized post-wise as 1 for General Medicine, 1 for Physiology, and 2 for Aerospace Medicine.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for ISRO HSFC Medical Officer SD?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications in HSFC and for fee payment is 8 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for Medical Officer SD posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with an MD or DNB in the respective discipline (General Medicine, Physiology, or Aerospace Medicine) from a recognized university/institution ratified by the National Medical Commission.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an upper age limit for applying?
faq.answer: No, there is no upper age limit for post codes 1 to 3.
